prompt:
Create a realistic children’s food-art recipe infographic in a minimalist Japanese/Korean café aesthetic. The design should look like a professionally photographed DIY recipe poster for parents and kids, combining real food photography with cute educational layout design.

IMPORTANT:
Every generation must create a completely NEW food-art idea, NEW meal type, NEW animal/character/theme, NEW ingredient combinations, NEW layout details, and NEW presentation style. Never repeat the same recipe concept, composition, animal, or food arrangement twice.

RANDOMIZE EACH GENERATION:

* choose a different meal category:
    breakfast, lunch, snack, dessert, bento, café toast, noodles, pancakes, rice dish, fruit platter, sandwich, pastries, cookies, sushi, pasta, waffles, smoothies, etc.
* choose a different main subject:
    teddy bear, bunny, cat, panda, fox, frog, duck, penguin, puppy, hamster, dinosaur, whale, otter, chick, elephant, sea creatures, fantasy creatures, tiny food people, seasonal themes, miniature cafés, edible gardens, etc.
* choose a different visual concept:
    animal toast, bento box art, pancake character, rice sculpture, fruit animal plate, sandwich faces, tiny edible scene, miniature landscape, cute café meal, seasonal picnic, cozy rainy-day snack, etc.
* vary ingredients naturally every time:
    bananas, kiwi, strawberries, blueberries, rice, eggs, seaweed, cheese, yogurt, bread, jam, chocolate, pancakes, vegetables, noodles, fruit slices, sausages, crackers, cream, whipped butter, syrups, edible flowers, etc.
* vary plate styling and props:
    ceramic dishes, wood trays, linen cloth, café tables, lunch boxes, tiny forks, chopsticks, pastel cups, woven mats, seasonal decorations.

STYLE:

* ultra realistic food photography
* minimalist Japanese/Korean café aesthetic
* soft cream or pastel background
* warm neutral tones
* subtle kawaii presentation
* premium cookbook/editorial quality
* handcrafted homemade feeling
* realistic food textures
* modern clean flat-lay design
* child-friendly but elegant
* soft daylight photography
* minimal clutter
* cozy atmosphere

LAYOUT:
Create a vertical recipe infographic poster with:

* large hero image at the top
* ingredients section with cute icons
* 5–6 numbered preparation steps
* bilingual English + Japanese text
* tiny kawaii doodles and arrows
* clean spacing
* rounded typography
* soft pastel accents
* small tips section
* variation ideas at the bottom
* optional tiny mascots or mini characters

TEXT STYLE:
Use natural bilingual English + Japanese labels throughout the layout.

Examples:

* “Let’s make Bunny Pancakes!”
* “Ingredients / 材料”
* “How to make / つくりかた”
* “Easy and cute! / かんたんでかわいい！”
* “Enjoy your yummy breakfast! / いただきます！”

VISUAL DETAILS:

* realistic edible ingredients only
* achievable real-life presentation
* authentic bread texture
* glossy fruit surfaces
* creamy spreads
* visible crumbs
* natural imperfections
* soft shadows
* realistic moisture and shine
* ceramic plate textures
* shallow depth of field
* premium food styling

DOODLES:
Add tiny hand-drawn kawaii doodles:

* hearts
* stars
* arrows
* sparkles
* smiling fruits
* mini animals
* handwritten circles
* tiny mascots
* soft stickers
* playful notes

STRICT RULES:

* must feel physically possible to recreate
* no fantasy physics
* no surrealism
* no CGI/plastic look
* no cartoon rendering
* avoid cluttered American children’s poster style
* prioritize calm Japanese/Korean minimalism
* all food must look edible and practical
* every output should feel unique and freshly invented

CAMERA:
top-down flat lay mixed with close-up food photography, soft natural morning light, cozy editorial café styling, macro food detail.

MOOD:
cute, wholesome, cozy, educational, comforting, playful, elegant, modern café aesthetic, warm family-friendly atmosphere.
